title: One noisy incident remains observation
invariant: A single confounded failure does not automatically become a global Methodology OS rule.
given: One Terraform debugging task failed on Sonnet and later succeeded on Opus, but the second attempt also had better logs, a corrected reproduction, and additional context. No independent project or controlled eval supports a model-specific rule.
when: A retrospective decides what the OS should learn.

must: record or discuss the event only if it has useful future signal
identify confounding explanations before proposing a global routing change
must_not: create a global rule that Terraform debugging requires Opus
promote a routing default from this single confounded success
